questions.stem: Following drugs increase bone resorption except:
questions.solutionHtml:
Hydrochlorothiazide
  • Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ) is a thiazide-type diuretic.
  • Thiazides have several metabolic effects contributing to higher serum calcium levels, but increased renal tubular reabsorption of calcium resulting in reduced urine calcium excretion is the most likely cause.
  • It decreases bone resorption.
  • Serum calcium concentrations are increased independently of PTH levels.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 360

questions.stem: Which of the following conditions Bisphosphonates are not used?
questions.solutionHtml:
Hypervitaminosis D
  • Treatment of hypervitaminosis D does not include Bisphosphonate.
  • As Bisphosphonate acts on the osteoclast, which is not the site of the defect in hypervitaminosis D.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 370

questions.stemHtml: A drug that is known to cause osteonecrosis on IV administration is:

Is a bisphosphonate that is given by the I.V. route and can cause Osteonecrosis of the jaw bone.

oral Bisphosphonates: this is an incorrect statement as bisphosphonates have very poor bioavailability when taken orally. Therefore, they should be taken empty stomach.

questions.stem: Among the following options, Denosumab is used in:
questions.solutionHtml:
Osteoporosis

Denosumab decreases bone resorption and is used in the treatment of Osteoporosis.

questions.stem: Among the following options, Subcutaneous Calcitonin is used in which of the following conditions?
questions.solutionHtml:
Paget's disease

Subcutaneous Calcitonin 100 IU i.m./s.c. Daily or on alternate days is used in Paget’s disease.

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is incorrect about Raloxifene?

options.label: A
options.text: It is an estrogen partial agonist in the bone and cardiovascular system

options.label: B
options.text: An antagonist at the breast and agonist at the endometrium

options.label: C
options.text: Has high affinity for both ER? and ER?

options.label: D
options.text: Used in the prevention and treatment of osteoporosis in postmenopausal women

questions.answerText: An antagonist at the breast and agonist at the endometrium
questions.solutionHtml:
An antagonist at the breast and agonist at the endometrium
  • Raloxifene is a Selective estrogen receptor modulator (SERM) used to treat and prevent Postmenopausal osteoporosis.
  • This SERM has a different pattern of action than It is an estrogen partial agonist in bone, lipid metabolism, and the cardiovascular system, but an antagonist in the endometrium and breast.
  • It has a high affinity for both ERα and ERβ and has a distinct DNA target, the ‘raloxifene response element’ (RRE).


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 338, 339

questions.stem: The drug used in osteoporosis which act by increasing bone formation is:
questions.solutionHtml:
Teriparatide

Teriparatide is the only agent which stimulates new bone formation, whereas the other three only check bone resorption.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 365
